sent_bad: Key differences in summary: The sideline survey is the immediate, on-the-spot screening (No-Go criteria, history, Maddocks questions, video review, focused neuro exam) done in the sideline tent on NFL-assigned technology, whose main function is to decide whether the player can return to play or must go to the locker room.

The locker room exam is the more comprehensive, standardized (SCAT 5-based) acute assessment performed in the locker room, used to diagnose concussion (including delayed-onset cases), track injury and recovery against preseason baseline, and generate documented records uploaded to the EMR.
